title: Last Transition Only For Selection Exit Highlight
description: Selection exit secondary chrome should reflect only the most recent selection change (deselected ids in that step), not accumulate all historical exits. Align delete_selection with the same rule.
summary: Selection exit secondary styling now reflects only the most recent change: `set_selection_exit_last_transition` replaces the highlight set with `prev \ next` each time instead of accumulating leavers across steps. `delete_selection` snapshots selection before mutations, applies the same rule, then prunes dead ids before emitting select.
